text: You slip the PRE-PUNCHED CARD into a slot on the TOTEM LATHE. Above, the TOOL ARM deploys a configuration of chisels.
Now you just need something to lathe.
alt: The PRE-PUNCHED CARD is slotted into the TOTEM LATHE. There is an empty space in it surrounded by two cylinders and a mechanical chisel arm.
command: John: Take cruxite to totem lathe.
